findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_cutluma, find_templates, make_editor_link, get_shared_video · Private data: make_editor_link, get_shared_video · Public sink: make_editor_link · Destructive: list_free_tools, find_templates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_cutluma, find_templates, make_editor_link, get_shared_video · Private data: make_editor_link, get_shared_video · Public sink: make_editor_link · Destructive: list_free_tools, find_templates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
